tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page ground on every screen. A warm paper white in light, a warm near-black in dark; never pure white or black.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces on `canvas`: dialogs, the settings popover, cards and the import prompt. Pair with `shadow-overlay` in light.

tokens.name: tile
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: hover on rows and buttons, chips, the note background and the year strip's empty weeks.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline rules between grid rows and sections. Decorative, so it carries no contrast duty; never a control border.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, outlined buttons and the stepper, and the 1.5px ring of a day not done. At least 3:1 on `canvas`, `panel` and `highlight`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `canvas`, `panel`, `tile` and `highlight`; the fill of the primary button (K8: one colour for act).

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `ink` fill: the primary button and the selected segment.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting text: dates, goals, hints, captions, eyebrow labels and a zero total. Never faded further.

tokens.name: error-ink
tokens.usage: Form and sync errors on `canvas` and `panel`, always with the circle-alert icon and words. Never for over the pick.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The keyboard focus ring: a solid 2px outline at 2px offset on every interactive element, on `canvas`, `panel` and `highlight`.

tokens.name: pen
tokens.usage: Done, and nothing else: the session dot and a met total. Set from the person's chosen ink (Ink blue by default). Never links, buttons or decoration; one pen colour on screen at a time.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Today, and nothing else: the band down today's column and today's row in the phone list.

tokens.name: caution-ink
tokens.usage: Over the daily pick, always with words ("one extra") and an underline. Never for errors.

tokens.name: ink-blue
tokens.usage: Ink choice: Ink blue, the default pen.

tokens.name: forest
tokens.usage: Ink choice: Forest. Saved green accents map here.

tokens.name: violet
tokens.usage: Ink choice: Violet. Saved purple accents map here.

tokens.name: graphite
tokens.usage: Ink choice: Graphite.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind a modal dialog, at 40% opacity. Only behind dialogs.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The week's date in the header, once per screen. Below 640px wide, 32/36.

styles.name: title-2
styles.usage: Dialog titles and the phone Today list's day heading.

styles.name: body-large
styles.sample: Two of three. One to go.
styles.usage: The single summary line under a section title.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: All running text, inputs, buttons and grid row names.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Supporting lines in `ink-secondary`: goals, hints, dates, eyebrow labels in sentence case.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, day initials and chips. Never uppercase or letter-spaced.

styles.name: note
styles.sample: Left shoulder felt tight on the last set.
styles.usage: A note on an exercise or a set, in italic. The person's words only; never a prompt.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap; between a label and its field.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between a field and its message; between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Padding inside buttons and inputs; grid cell padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Side gutter on phones; gap between stacked form parts.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel padding; gap between a section title and its grid.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between the Exercises and Diet sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Side gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Space above the footer and below the last section.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Fields, tiles and chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, icon buttons and segmented controls.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels: dialogs, the settings popover, cards.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Day marks: the done dot and the empty ring.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Overlays only: dialogs and the popover. In dark the `panel` colour does the lifting.
